author: JerryRigEverything
description:
Today we are planting the worlds largest Smiley Face. All powered by the new Anker SOLIX S5000. Get your discount HERE: https://ankersolix.tech/US_SOLIX_S5000_NPL_JerryRigEverything_820875 I know @AnkerSOLIX can accomplish big things - but this might just be the largest DIY project of all time. And HUGE thanks to Anker for sponsoring the Project

Jerry's Cabin is a happy place for our family - so its just natural that we plant the worlds largest smiley face out of Douglas Fir Pine trees.   Yeah - it'll take a few years for the trees to grow large enough to see it from space -but it will be worth it! 

Would you smile if you saw a smile on the ground?
